import os,re,numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for i,(ik,ok) in enumerate([('*Demo pair %d'%j,'Demo pair %d output'%j) for j in [1,2,3]]):
    D=np.array(G[ik]); O=np.array(G[ok])
    bg=D[0][0]
    lab,n=ndimage.label(D!=bg, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    preds=D.copy()
    for j in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==j)
        for r,c in zip(rs,cs): preds[r][c+1]=D[r][c]
    print('pair',i+1,'match:',np.array_equal(preds,O))

import numpy as np, os, re
from scipy import ndimage
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

for j in [3]:
    D=np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%j]); O=np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%j])
    lab,n=ndimage.label(D!=D[0][0], structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    print('pair',j,'objects:',n)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==i)
        mr,Mr=int(min(rs)),int(max(rs)); mc,Mc=int(min(cs)),int(max(cs))

        print('  obj',i,'bbox',(mr,Mr,mc,Mc),'col',col,'ncells',len(zip(*np.where(D==col))) if False else int((D==col).sum()))
    print(' out cells per col:')
    for v in np.unique(O):
        cells=list(map(tuple,np.argwhere(O==v)))
        print('  ',v,'->',cells)

import numpy as np, os, re
from scipy import ndimage
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(I):
    I=np.array(I); h,w=I.shape
    bg=int(I[0][0])
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I!=bg, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=np.full((h,w),bg,dtype=int)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==i)
        col=int(I[rs[0],cs[0]])
        Mc=int(max(cs))
        shifted={(r,c+1) for r,c in zip(rs,cs)}
        kept={(r,c) for r,c in shifted if c<=Mc}
        ch,ci=ndimage.convex_hull(*np.vstack(sorted(kept)), output='points', method=None)
        pts=set(map(tuple,ch.tolist()))
        for r,c in pts:
            if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=col
        # erase original cells
        for r,c in zip(rs,cs):
            if out[r][c]==col: out[r][c]=bg
    return out

for j in range(1,4):
    p=f(G['Demo pair %d input'%j])
    o=G['Demo pair %d output'%j]
    print('pair',j,'match:',np.array_equal(p,np.array(o)))
    if not np.array_equal(p,np.array(o)):
        D,O=np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%j]),np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%j])
        diff=[(int(r),int(c),int(p[r][c]),int(O[r][c])) for r in range(D.shape[0]) for c in range(D.shape[1]) if p[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
        print(' diffs:',len(diff),diff[:12])

T=G['Test input']
import json
print(json.dumps(f(T).tolist()))

import numpy as np, os, re
from scipy import ndimage
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(I):
    I=np.array(I); h,w=I.shape
    bg=int(I[0][0])
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I!=bg, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=I.copy()
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==i)
        col=int(I[rs[0],cs[0]])
        mr,Mr=min(rs),max(rs); mc,Mc=min(cs),max(cs)
        # erase original object
        for r,c in zip(rs,cs):
            if out[r][c]==col: out[r][c]=bg
        # paint hollow rect rows mr..Mr, cols mc+1..Mc
        for r in range(mr,Mr+1):
            for c in range(mc+1,Mc+1):
                if (r in (mr,Mr) or c in (mc+1,Mc)) and out[r][c]==bg:
                    out[r][c]=col
    return out

for j in range(1,4):
    p=f(G['Demo pair %d input'%j]); o=np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%j])
    print('pair',j,'match:',np.array_equal(p,o))
    if not np.array_equal(p,o):
        D=np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%j])
        diff=[(int(r),int(c),int(p[r][c]),int(o[r][c])) for r in range(D.shape[0]) for c in range(D.shape[1]) if p[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
        print(' diffs:',len(diff),diff)
T=G['Test input']
out=f(T)
import json
print(json.dumps(out.tolist()))

```python
def f(I):
    I=np.array(I); h,w=I.shape; bg=int(I[0][0])
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I!=bg, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=I.copy()
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==i)
        col=int(I[rs[0],cs[0]])
        mr,Mr=min(rs),max(rs); mc,Mc=min(cs),max(cs)
        for r,c in zip(rs,cs):
            if out[r][c]==col: out[r][c]=bg
        nb = [mr,Mc]  # row range same, col range mc+1..Mc
        for r in range(mr,Mr+1):
            for c in range(nb[0],nb[1]+1):
                if r in (mr,Mr) or c in (nb[0],nb[1]):
                    if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=col
    return out
```
